slides.title: WHO: a health system near collapse
slides.body: The WHO chief's warning on northern Ethiopia

slides.title: A newborn among the dead
slides.body: WHO head Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says children, including a newborn, were reportedly killed at the Jaari 2 displacement camp in Amhara.

slides.title: people killed in drone strikes on the camp
slides.body: Several of them children, rescue sources told Reuters, as reported by Al Jazeera.

slides.title: Killed while seeking food
slides.body: In Rama, Tigray, several people were reportedly killed while trying to get food, Tedros said. He named no perpetrators.

slides.title: Hospitals running short
slides.body: Too few health workers, medicines and equipment. Ambulances are severely limited and insecurity is blocking supplies, WHO says.

slides.title: What is at risk next
slides.body: WHO warns more people may lose emergency care, maternal and child health services and disease treatment.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let health care through.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: WHO via UN News, AP, Al Jazeera · Nov 2, 2026
